supersedes: v003 (same parts, sockets, pivots, root and idle numbers; poses/portrait/stage changed - see INTEGRATION-DELTA-v003-to-v003.1.md). v002 coordinates remain NOT interchangeable.

stage.note: v003.1 grows the DRAWING SURFACE, not the rig: the 640x640 rig frame and every manifest number are unchanged. Draw the rig translated by rig_origin inside an 800x800 stage (or allow overflow of 160 px above and 80 px on each side of the 640 frame). Victory and the A2 strike/follow-through/windup poses use this margin; idle and defeat stay inside the 640 frame. Mirror still happens about rig x=320 (stage x=400).

2x.note: same coordinates (all manifest numbers are 1x canvas px); draw @2x tiles at 0.5 scale. Use on >=2x screens when the bot is drawn wider than ~320 px.

coordinate_system: top-left XY; +X right, +Y down; clockwise-positive degrees; column-vector affine matrices; all numbers in 1x canvas px
paint_composite_order: mask alpha tinted to paint token
alpha: straight/unassociated RGBA PNG; sRGB; no baked background
mirror: Mirror the complete assembled hierarchy about x=320 (x_new = 640 - x). Never flip tiles independently. l/r = view-left(rear)/view-right(front).
hierarchy_note: hand_l_wrap/hand_r_wrap are children of their hand (socket "wrap" = hand pivot, angle 0). The equipped weapon is a child of hand_r.grip.

sword.draw_order_note: hand back layer < weapon < hand *_wrap layer for every gripping hand

axe.draw_order_note: hand back layer < weapon < hand *_wrap layer for every gripping hand
axe.off_grip_released_reason: victory raises the axe one-handed (two-handed overhead does not fit the rig reach/canvas); defeat lets go with the rear hand. In every other pose the off hand is on grip_off.
axe.off_hand_rule: hand_l is NOT parented to the weapon. Every pose ships baked hand_l rotations that land hand_l.grip on weapon_axe.grip_off (validated <= 1.5 px / 2 deg). If an engine blends poses, blend all rots; do not re-solve.

dagger.draw_order_note: hand back layer < weapon < hand *_wrap layer for every gripping hand
dagger.grip_style_reason: Reverse (ice-pick) grip: blade leaves the little-finger side and angles down toward the opponent. At fight scale it gives the dagger a silhouette that cannot be mistaken for a short sword, and its guard reads as a raised fist.

assets.note: curled fingers/thumb drawn OVER the weapon handle; same tile/pivot as its hand; always drawn

idle.use: stable / customise / fight idle. Per-weapon guard.

victory.use: result overlay, own bot. v003.1: weapon arm raised overhead-forward, weapon high and diagonal, chest open, chin up, rear fist pumped up-back (V silhouette). Uses the stage margin above the rig frame.

defeat.use: result overlay / KO hold. Both knees down, slumped, head hanging, weapon grounded. v003.1: both knees AND both toe caps touch ground_y (toes tucked), no floating knees, boots no longer read as slabs.

portrait.use: ranking head-and-shoulders portrait source pose. Per weapon: render it WITH the bot's own equipped weapon and own paint (see portrait.rule).

walk_in.use: passing pose of the entrance walk (alternate with idle while translating)

windup.use: anticipation; weapon never crosses the face (validated)

strike.use: contact extreme, smear-friendly (fully extended arc end)

dodge.use: evade: weight thrown back and low

hit_react.use: taking a hit: torso and head snapped back

knockout.use: KO launch: thrown back, front leg kicked up; blend into defeat

quick_attack.use: v002/F7 name kept for compatibility; identical numbers to "strike"

heavy_windup.use: v002/F7 name kept for compatibility; identical numbers to "windup"

pose_format.rot: degrees ADDED to the part's default `angle`, rotating around its own pivot. Missing part = 0. torso.rot is the root rotation.
pose_format.weapon: never posed directly; it follows hand_r via grips.main.attach_angle
pose_format.blend: linear interpolation of root.x/y and each rot is valid between any two entries of the same weapon (rots are stored nearest the weapon's idle value, so no joint spins). Two-handed axe: the off hand is exact at each key, and can drift a few px mid-blend.
pose_format.aliases: pose_aliases maps v002/F7 motionPose names to A2 names; the alias entries are also present in poses with identical numbers.

face.use: QA only: visor+brow area in head-tile px. No weapon pixel may enter it in windup; checked by validate_kit_v0031.py.

walk_in.note: repeat walk_in<->idle while root.x travels ~7 px/frame (1x rig px)

attack.note: only when the hit connects; on a whiff skip to follow_through

hit_react.note: starts on the attacker hit-stop frame 1; victim also freezes for hit_stop_frames

knockout.note: KO hit-stop is longer than a normal hit
then ~1 s hold before the result overlay

walk_in.note: repeat walk_in<->idle while root.x travels ~5 px/frame

timing.how_to_play: A sequence is a list of segments. Segment k blends from the previous pose to "to" over "frames" frames using "ease" (linear | ease-in | ease-out | ease-in-out; "hold" and "hit-stop" keep the pose frozen). Hit-stop freezes BOTH bots for hit_stop_frames on contact; skip the hit-stop segment on a miss. reducedMotion: skip walk_in bob, snap between keys, keep hit-stop at 0 frames, still show result plates.

defeat_sparks.orientation: screen-up (position follows the socket; do not inherit torso rotation)
defeat_sparks.playback: optional one-shot on KO hold; frames 00-02 then hide; static frame 01 for reduced motion or skip

portrait.rule: Each bot's portrait is rendered from THAT bot's own loadout: its paintId (paint_tokens[paintId], or the paint's hex composited material_under + tinted paint_mask + material_over) and its weaponId (pose poses.portrait[weaponId], drawing weapons[weaponId].asset with the normal grip/z rules). Never reuse or recolour the shipped sample PNGs; they are references for QA only. Re-render whenever paintId or weaponId changes (cache key: kit version + paintId/hex + weaponId + size).
portrait.facing: right (canonical); mirror only if the row layout requires it
portrait.filter: render the full 640 assembly at >= 2x parts, then crop and Lanczos-downsample
portrait.note: crop is anchored to the world position of torso.neck in the portrait pose, so any future head/torso part or paint keeps the framing

loadout.paint_label: Scrap Green: TEST paint, not in the catalog; proves the render is driven by the loadout, not by the two sample paints

mapping.reducedMotion: snap to the target pose, no tween; result plates still shown

validation_summary.meaning: Geometry/file/raster proof from manifest + PNGs. Not art acceptance, native performance, animation timing or full collision clearance.
